verdict.rationale: Decagon's Duet acts as an in-product AI helper that lets (non-technical) users delegate specific tasks — auto-generating Agent Operating Procedures from past conversations, drafting tests, and producing content suggestions — which is a form of delegating work to a built-in assistant, but it's narrowly scoped to agent-configuration/QA tasks rather than a general-purpose assistant for arbitrary user tasks. missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose in-product assistant handling open-ended user requests beyond AOP/test/content generation, independent/hands-on validation of Duet's delegation quality, and detail on how broadly tasks can be delegated versus templated workflows.
